summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in providing essential broadband infrastructure for modern public education and urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program rather than eliminate it. The comment expresses support for preserving E-Rate funding to ensure schools maintain connectivity for students, emphasizing the importance of reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity for educational success.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would lead to significant cost increases for school districts, potentially requiring cuts to other essential services
claims.evidence_quote: Eastchester Union Free School District has received $62,072 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $12,414 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.

claims.argument: Protecting E-Rate ensures schools maintain connectivity for students
claims.evidence_quote: I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure that public schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
